description_en: Creates an experiment group in a specified layer. You can use experiment groups to categorize experiments and observe their overall performance
description_zh: 在指定层下，创建一个实验组。可按照实验类型划分实验组，从而按照实验组观测实验整体效果表现
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice create-experiment-group --layer-id 3 --name experiment_group_test --description This_is_a_test. --debug-users 1124512470000000,1124512471000000,1124512472000000 --debug-crowd-id 3 --need-aa true --filter gender=male --crowd-id 1 --distribution-type UserId --distribution-time-duration 3 --config RankBy_:_Score --reserved-buckets 1,2,3 --instance-id pairec-test1 --crowd-target-type All --random-flow 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateExperimentGroup

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the experiment group
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en: The ID of the crowd for crowd targeting. You can obtain this ID by calling the ListCrowds operation
parameters.help_zh: 人群定向的指定人群ID，可通过接口ListCrowds获取
parameters.name: crowd_id

parameters.help_en:
The crowd targeting type for the experiment group. Valid values:

`All`: All traffic

`Filter`: Traffic that matches the filter condition

`CrowdId`: Traffic from a specific crowd

`Random`: A random percentage of traffic
parameters.help_zh:
实验组流量定向的类型，可能的取值包括：
All 所有的流量
Filter 使用过滤条件的流量
CrowdId 通过指定人群ID
Random 按照百分比随机流量
parameters.name: crowd_target_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the debug crowd. You can obtain this ID by calling the ListCrowds operation
parameters.help_zh: 调试人群ID，可通过接口ListCrowds获取
parameters.name: debug_crowd_id

parameters.help_en: The UIDs of the debug users. The value must be the UID of an Alibaba Cloud account or a RAM user. Separate multiple UIDs with a comma
parameters.help_zh: 调试用户（需为阿里云账户主账号/子账号uid），多个用户需通过逗号作间隔
parameters.name: debug_users

parameters.help_en: The description of the experiment group
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The time duration for traffic distribution
parameters.name: distribution_time_duration

parameters.help_en: The distribution type. Valid values: `UserId` (by user ID) and `TimeDuration` (by time duration)
parameters.help_zh:
分流方式。
● UserId-用户ID
● TimeDuration-时段
parameters.name: distribution_type

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for crowd targeting
parameters.help_zh: 人群定向指定的过滤条件
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the ListInstances operation
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the layer. You can obtain this ID by calling the ListLayers operation
parameters.name: layer_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the experiment group
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to create an A/A experiment group
parameters.name: need_aa

parameters.help_en: The percentage of traffic to randomly allocate to this experiment group. This parameter is used only when `CrowdTargetType` is set to `Random`. Valid values: 0 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 当实验组流量定向的类型是Random时，使用随机流量匹配这个实验组，可能的取值范围是 0 - 100
parameters.name: random_flow

parameters.help_en: A comma-separated list of reserved bucket numbers
parameters.name: reserved_buckets

ExperimentGroupId.description_en: The ID of the experiment group
